evals.prompt: /debate Should students use AI for homework?
evals.expected_output: A full 3-round debate transcript with all 5 agents (Visionary, Skeptic, Engineer, Economist, Ethicist) plus a judge summary section containing: best argument per agent, biggest disagreement, final consensus, winning agent, and a concrete recommendation.
expectations: All 5 agents appear in Round 1 (Opening Arguments): Visionary, Skeptic, Engineer, Economist, Ethicist
Round 2 (Crossfire) shows agents responding to each other — at least one response explicitly targets another agent's argument
Round 3 (Final Positions) contains all 5 agents giving their final stance
The Judge's Summary section is present and names a winning agent
The Judge's Summary includes a 'What you should do' recommendation

evals.prompt: /debate I'm considering building a startup that replaces junior developers with AI coding agents. Should I do it?
evals.expected_output: A 3-round debate treating this as a startup idea review. All 5 personas weigh in from their angle (Visionary: market upside; Skeptic: assumptions; Engineer: technical feasibility; Economist: unit economics and labor markets; Ethicist: workforce displacement). Judge summary names the key tension and gives a go/no-go style recommendation.
expectations: All 5 agents appear in all 3 rounds
The Economist addresses labor market impact or cost structure
The Ethicist addresses workforce displacement or fairness
The Skeptic challenges at least one specific assumption
The judge summary gives a concrete recommendation (not just 'it depends')
A transcript JSON file is saved to /tmp/

evals.prompt: Debate this for me: should a city ban cars from its downtown core within the next 5 years?
evals.expected_output: A policy debate where the 5 agents engage the urban planning question from their perspectives. Includes economic tradeoffs (Economist), infrastructure feasibility (Engineer), quality-of-life upside (Visionary), unintended harms (Ethicist), and risk of overpromising (Skeptic). Full 3 rounds plus judge summary.
expectations: The skill triggers correctly even without the /debate slash command — just from the word 'debate' in the prompt
All 5 agents appear in all 3 rounds
At least one agent specifically mentions implementation timeline or infrastructure
The crossfire round shows at least one direct quote or reference to another agent's argument
Judge summary identifies the biggest disagreement between two named agents
